verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Team Comments blog post says teammates can be @mentioned and can coordinate responses beside an email, and that external recipients never see these internal discussions. That covers the core of the side-thread story and replaces forwarding copies around. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how comment threads work (placement beside the message, notifications, permissions), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the feature works as described.
